Age shouldn’t be a risk

AXA is committed to a society where every generation has its place.

Discover our Global and Local Initiatives

Our new Global Brand Campaign takes on one of the defining anxieties of our time - demographic change - and flips it.

Each chapter of our platform is designed to do more than advertise: it stakes a position on a major societal issue, drives a cultural conversation, and demonstrates that AXA's role extends far beyond insurance.

This campaign is our answer: a deliberate, optimistic reframe of ageing, from perceived risk to source of collective progress. It positions AXA as the long-term partner for an inclusive, intergenerational society.

But this is not just a brand statement - it is a commitment backed by substance.

Discover our new global brand campaign.

Across our markets, the global message will be amplified by local proof points that demonstrate we mean it.

LIFE & SAVINGS AND BUSINESS INSURANCE

Succession and transmission planning that helps individuals and businesses navigate life's most significant transitions.

  • Hong Kong

    Preparing wealth for future generations

    Our Savings protection offers flexible wealth transfer to 3 recipients. Heritage protection by contingent ownership ensures continuity. Unlimited insured changes extend coverage to 138.

  • Japan

    Responding to the realities of an ageing society

    Japan's aging population creates labor shortages, threatening SMEs- 99.7% of companies. AXA Japan supports these vital businesses through targeted initiatives addressing labor challenges and driving sustainable growth for all.

  • Spain

    Protecting what matters through life's uncertainties

    At AXA, we offer tailored Life and Savings solutions, designed to support you and give you security at every stage of life.

  • Belgium

    Adapting protection to every stage of life

    AXA adapts its savings and investment solutions to every stage of life and budget, helping protect and pass on wealth while delivering long‑term peace of mind.

  • Germany

    Adapting Life and Savings to evolving life paths

    Single-premium and unit-linked solutions supporting different life stages and social needs with flexible, tax-efficient retirement options, guarantees & sustainable investing.

  • Switzerland

    Building long term financial resilience across life stages

    Demonstrating AXA’s holistic expertise on retirement provision for all ages providing tailored products to secure long-term financial stability across all life stages.

  • Turkey

    INVEST in Your Future, at Every Stage of Life

    AXA provides life-long insurance solutions to achieve your savings goals with flexible protection and retirement products.

HEALTH

A multigenerational approach to care, and pushing age boundaries to ensure everyone can live healthier, longer, and more fulfilling lives.

  • France

    "Mon RDV Prévention"

    At any age, prevention is the most effective way to take care of yourself. That is why AXA funds a preventive health assessment within its Health insurance plans to help people live better, longer and in better health.

  • Krungthai - AXA Life

    Maintaining health at every age

    Krungthai - AXA Life breaks traditional limit of healthcare access through prevention, early detection and extended protection ensuring coverage across generations.

  • United Kingdom

    Multi-generational family health plans

    With the AXA Health Plan, you can tailor your cover to include family members up to two generations from you, even if they live at different addresses. Pre-existing conditions aren't covered.

AXA AS AN EMPLOYER

Walking the talk - because the most powerful proof that age shouldn't be a risk is the one we demonstrate from within.

  • Global

    We Care - Parental support

    The AXA Group Parental Policy is designed to reflect the diversity of our people. We recognize that families are unique and there are many paths to becoming a parent.

  • Global

    We Care - Caregiver support

    Many employees balance work with caring for family members who may need additional support. The caregiver policy is designed to help our employees manage these responsibilities.
